_provenance: The Yes/No answers Generate asks the filer to confirm before writing the instance (docs/14 Step 5, webXBRL's confirmation of key answers). Each one decides which other items MCA requires (a booleanDependencies parent): a wrong answer silently opens or closes whole disclosures. The builder checks every concept is a boolean dependency parent of this taxonomy. Chosen by the product owner 2026-11-14.

keyAnswers.why: Holding company: opens the holding company's shareholding in the share capital note.
Subsidiaries: opens the number of subsidiaries and the subsidiary disclosures.
CSR applicable: No closes the CSR policy, prescribed expenditure and spending items.
Auditor's report qualified: Yes requires the auditor's qualifications / reservations / adverse remarks.
